title: Mythos Finds a Curl Vulnerability
summary: Daniel Stenberg (curl creator) blog post about a vulnerability discovered in curl by researcher Mythos. The article discusses a security flaw found in the widely-used command-line tool for data transfer.
problem_solved: Discovered and documented a security vulnerability in the curl tool to help protect users from potential exploitation.
why_valuable: As curl is used by billions of systems worldwide, identifying and patching vulnerabilities is critical for internet security infrastructure.
